meta.title: Zazu · The operating system for your water sports school
meta.description: Online bookings, payments and student management for surf, sailing, kite and dive schools in Spain. Built for the water. Book your demo.

hero.sub: Zazu brings bookings, payments, students and camps into one place. Built for surf, sailing, kite and dive schools. Set up and ready before your season starts.
hero.imageAlt: A surfer crossing the dunes toward the waves at golden hour, board under one arm

problem.title: Summer shouldn't be chaos.
problem.lead: If any of this sounds familiar, you're not doing it wrong. You're just doing it by hand.
items: Your phone melting down in July with WhatsApp bookings.
Deposits you don't collect in time and spots you lose.
A different spreadsheet per instructor, and nobody knows real occupancy.
Paperwork for minors: IDs, insurance and consents out of control.

value.title: Booking is only the beginning.
value.body: Most tools help you take bookings and little else. Zazu runs your whole school end-to-end —payments, students, camps, gear and the day-to-day— in one system, not five disconnected apps, a spreadsheet and WhatsApp.
value.cycleCaption: Your school's full cycle, in one place.

features.title: Everything that happens after the booking, handled.

featured.title: Your season, under control
featured.body: Operations calendar, attendance and assignable gear from your phone. Every instructor hits the beach knowing who they've got, when, and with what kit. Minors, guardians, medical data and consents always in order.
featured.imageAlt: Wetsuits and drysuits hanging in the wooden gear room of a sailing school, with a life ring in the background

items.q: I don't have time to learn another tool.
items.a: That's why onboarding is done-for-you: we set up services, calendar and card terminal, and import your students. You start using it, not building it.

items.q: I manage with WhatsApp and a spreadsheet, I get by.
items.a: You get by in the low season. In July you lose spots and hours. Add up what a lost spot and an hour of your time are worth: Zazu pays for itself.

items.q: Isn't it expensive for how seasonal I am?
items.a: The entry plan costs less than one or two spots a month, and helps you sell more and collect what slips away today. We also have pre-season terms.

items.q: I have no card terminal and don't know about online payments.
items.a: We walk you through setting up a Redsys terminal, or we use an alternative gateway. No headaches.

items.q: I already use another booking tool.
items.a: Great that you're digital. Zazu goes beyond booking: camps, minors, documents, gear and attendance. And we migrate you at no cost.

items.q: What if I want to leave?
items.a: Your data is yours and we export it. No forced lock-in beyond the annual term if you choose monthly billing.
